gaps.sentence: Only in an emergency ___ this exit be used.
gaps.explanation: may + be + participle: this exit may be used only in an emergency.

gaps.sentence: Nowhere ___ the report mention the missing funds.
gaps.explanation: Nowhere does the report mention… — present simple inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only by training every day ___ she hope to qualify.
gaps.explanation: 'Only by training every day could she hope …' — inverted modal.

gaps.sentence: Seldom have I been so ___ by a performance.
gaps.explanation: 'moved' — the audience was emotionally affected; inversion with have been.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ a debut film attracted such wide attention.
gaps.explanation: 'Rarely has a debut film attracted …' — perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Never ___ I expect to see my own name on the shortlist.
gaps.explanation: 'Never did I expect …' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Never ___ I seen such a mess in this office.
gaps.explanation: 'Never had I seen' — inversion after fronted 'never', past perfect of 'see'.

gaps.sentence: To such an extent ___ prices risen that buyers withdrew.
gaps.hint: To such an extent + past perfect
gaps.explanation: To such an extent had prices risen that… — emphatic result.
